comment: The README says the clone runs at 12-bit resolution; the code carries the envelope as a 16-bit level, 0 to 65535, scaled to 0V-10V (V101-Dual_Envelope.cpp:243-244). The 1kHz rate the README gives is in the code as RT_TASK_RATE. The D knob is read only in ADSR mode: in AR and LFO the attack phase goes straight to release (V101-Dual_Envelope.cpp:438-444), and the S level is likewise never reached. Attack, decay and release times come from a 128-entry step table indexed by the knob, fastest at the counter-clockwise end. The two channels share nothing but the panel, so the A, D, S, R and MODE lines are each tagged to both of that control's knobs.
